Hints.FreeRoll: Hold Shift to roll without spending a NET action (e.g. defending against an attack).

Ability.scanner: Find the physical access points of nearby architectures. A meat action — it happens in the room, not in the NET.
Ability.backdoor: Break a password. Beat the floor's DV and the way down opens.
Ability.cloak: Cover your tracks and any virus you left. Another netrunner must beat your roll with Pathfinder to see what you did.
Ability.control: Take a control node — cameras, turrets, doors, lifts. Each device on it costs another NET action.
Ability.eyedee: Work out what a file is and what it is worth.
Ability.pathfinder: Map the floors below you. The better the roll, the deeper you see; a lock you cannot beat stops that branch.
Ability.slide: Break away from one Black ICE and slip to the next floor. Not demons, and only once per turn.
Ability.virus: Leave something behind that outlives the run. Only at the bottom of a branch.
Ability.zap: A bare attack on a program or another netrunner: 1d6 straight to the target.
Ability.speed: Your reaction when Black ICE catches you on a floor. Free.
Ability.defense: Your defence against an attack in the NET. Free.

Dim.backdoor: Not lit: this floor has no lock, or it is already open.

Dim.slide: Not lit: pick a Black ICE as your target first.

Hints.ControlNode:
Make a node you hold do its thing — open the door, kill the lights, run the lift.

Costs one NET action.
Hints.ControlRelease: Stop holding a node. Costs nothing, but taking it back means another Control Node roll against its DV.

Asp.name: Asp
Asp.effect: Destroys a single random program installed on the target netrunner's cyberdeck.

Giant.name: Giant
Giant.effect: Does 3d6 damage directly to the target netrunner's brain. They are forcibly and unsafely jacked out of the NET architecture, suffering any consequences (except Giant).

Hellhound.name: Hellhound
Hellhound.effect: Does 2d6 damage directly to the target netrunner's brain. Unless insulated, their cyberdeck catches fire along with their clothing. Until they spend a meat action to put themselves out, they take 2 damage directly to their HP whenever they end their turn. This effect does not stack.

Kraken.name: Kraken
Kraken.effect: Does 3d6 damage directly to the target netrunner's brain. Until the end of their next turn, the target netrunner cannot progress deeper into the NET architecture, or jack out safely. They can still jack out unsafely, though.

Liche.name: Liche
Liche.effect: Target netrunner's INT, REF, and DEX are all lowered by 1d6 (minimum 1). The effect is largely psychosomatic and wears off after one hour.

Raven.name: Raven
Raven.effect: Derezzes a single random defender program which the target netrunner has rezzed, and deals 1d6 damage directly to their brain.

Scorpion.name: Scorpion
Scorpion.effect: Target netrunner's MOVE is lowered by 1d6 (minimum 1). The effect is largely psychosomatic and wears off after one hour.

Skunk.name: Skunk
Skunk.effect: Until this program is derezzed, the target netrunner has -2 to all slide checks. Skunk can only affect a single netrunner, but the effects of multiple skunks can stack.

Wisp.name: Wisp
Wisp.effect: Does 1d6 damage directly to the target netrunner's brain, and lowers the number of NET actions they can take on their next turn by 1 (minimum 2).
